description_en: Queries the information about a containerized application
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-container-apps --field-value cas-adad-qeqwe --current-page 1 --page-size 200 --cluster-id ca0a686115432429ca26cf780f5e9fff5 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeContainerApps

parameters.help_en: The application value that you want to query. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的应用值，支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: field_value

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page.

>  We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
> 建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the container cluster
parameters.name: cluster_id
